parts.latex:
Use the table of future values of \$1 to find the future value of \$3000 invested per year at $6\%$ p.a. for 4 years, with interest compounded every 6 months.

\extable{497_q24_t1}

solutions.latex:
Interest is compounded every 6 months for 4 years, so there are $8$ periods at $3\%$ per period; the table factor is $8.8923$.
$$\begin{aligned} FV &= 3000 \times 8.8923 \\ &= \$26\,676.90 \end{aligned}$$
criteria: Uses the correct table value, or equivalent merit
